meta.title: Why Munib Tracker — Private, Ad-Free and Built on Authentic Sources
meta.description: The principles behind Munib Tracker: consistency over guilt, privacy by default, no ads, authentic cited sources, offline-first, and free for everyone.

title: A worship companion that's on your side
intro: Many Islamic apps are funded by ads or subscriptions, which pulls them towards more screen time and more data. Munib Tracker is built differently: to help you turn back to Allah, then get out of the way.
heroCaption: Downloaded content is stored on your device.

consistency.title: Consistency, not guilt
consistency.text: Munib is a Qur'anic word for someone who turns back to Allah. The app is built for coming back: missed Salah are recorded honestly but gently, excused days don't break your streak, and levels never run out.

privacy.title: Private by default
privacy.text: No account is needed for personal use. Without signing in, your worship record stays on your device; only the Masjid finder looks up nearby masjids through our server, using a rough area of about 5 km, and family features share just a small signal. Qur'an practice processes your voice on the device and never uploads it.

noAds.title: No ads, ever
noAds.text: Worship deserves focus. There are no ads, no advertising SDKs, no subscriptions and no in-app purchases.

authentic.title: Authentic, cited content
authentic.text: Qur'an text, translations, hadith, adhkar and duas come from established open datasets, never written by hand or generated. Sources are listed on our [credits page](/credits).

offline.title: Offline-first
offline.text: Tracking, the Qur'an text, adhkar, duas and the learning library all work without a connection, so the app is there on a flight or in a basement Masjid.

open.title: Open for anyone to check
open.text: The source code is public on GitHub under a non-commercial licence, so anyone can see how it works. [Learn about our open-source approach](/open-source).

items.ads: Show ads or sell your data
items.leaderboards: Rank you against other people on leaderboards
items.aiText: Replace Qur'an, hadith or adhkar text with AI-generated or hand-typed versions
items.fatwas: Issue fatwas: calculators and guides point you to qualified scholars

more.title: One calm place for your daily worship
more.body: Munib Tracker brings together what usually takes several apps: a [Salah tracker](/features/salah-tracker), a [Qaza planner](/features/qaza-salah-tracker), [adhkar with sources](/features/zikr-tracker), the Qur'an with [recitation practice](/features/quran-practice), and a cited [learning library](/learn). Compare it honestly with other apps on our [comparison pages](/compare).
